scope: H16 existing actual original entry + single close + terminal unused stop; no shared contract or financial semantics change

recipe.action: Drain dispatch/position/funding outboxes first. Persist actual canonical funding before terminal stop reconcile while current EXIT_REQUESTED binding remains READY. Funding _context requires restart_authoritative, so cannot simply be called after terminal stop changes execution snapshot. If funding absent after stop, deny finalization; do not synthesize Paper zero or weaken funding owner.

Resolve original same-run claimed ENTRY, exactly one original POSITION_EXIT/EMERGENCY_EXIT, exactly one original PROTECTION_STOP and immutable cleanup claim. Bind entry/close/stop prepared plan/action/source hashes and original native position/account/provider. Resolve exact saved close publication referenced by funding close_publication_hash and cleanup flat_publication_hash, not a later observation selected by latest(). Its RAW_POSITION and EXIT_REQUESTED projection must be CONSISTENT zero at the first proven flat broker clock; funding interval ends at this exact clock. Reject a later incompatible current projection/raw anchor rather than rebasing the close clock.

Recover canonical immutable objects. Check exactly known entry/close/stop requests, all latest results terminal, exact stop CANCELED from targeted original reconcile (cancel ACK is insufficient), no stop fills/triggered child, all entry quantity fully filled and exact close fill quantity; fresh complete claim/inventory evidence must establish no remaining owned/unknown active order. Only expected old-binding REINTERPRETATION_REQUIRED/E5_EXECUTION_REINTERPRETATION_REQUIRED may enter new finalization preparation. Conflict, unknown/degraded result, missing facts, new raw anchor, unrelated mutation or additional close denies.

Call build_trade_result(parent_plan, current_lifecycle_state=EXIT_REQUESTED, exit_authority=exact recovered close PositionAction, entry_order_requests=[original canonical entry request], entry_fills=actual canonical entry fills, exit_order_request=exact original close request, exit_fills=actual canonical close fills, final_position=saved first-flat RAW_POSITION, funding_evidence=exact durable canonical funding payload). Decode OrderRequest/Fill facts with existing encode/decode adapters where required, not provider dictionaries. Consumer enforces entry quantity=exit quantity=close request=action quantity, chronological fills, fees and funding interval/identity. Do not concatenate additional close requests or include stop as exit authority.

Pass returned actual TradeResultBuildOutcome unchanged to build_position_lifecycle_closed_transition(saved_first_flat_raw, saved_flat_EXIT_REQUESTED_projection, trade_result_outcome=outcome, lifecycle_interpreted_at=one saved local finalization timestamp). Exact flat clock remains unchanged. Build binding for NEW CLOSED projection with all recovered order_requests, ALL order_result_observations and fills. Include original stop OPEN and terminal CANCELED observations, not only current_order_results. Entry facts are supplied but clean entry is excluded from position-linked snapshot by canonical builder. Never attach a replacement binding to immutable old projection.

Commit a typed E6-local finalization outbox BEFORE canonical publication. Exact ordered effects: POSITION_PROJECTION(CLOSED), LIFECYCLE_EXECUTION_BINDING(new complete binding), TRADE_RESULT(outcome.trade_result). Funding already durable; raw flat/action/requests/results/fills already durable, so no extra or invented effects. Use publish_canonical_effects normal writers. Binding requires projection durable; TradeResult facade validates actual referenced plan/actions/requests/fills and funding persistence validates interval/status/cost. Canonical writes commit individually, so receipt only after all three and final recover READY/CLOSED with exact result/funding/binding IDs.

rules: Position-scoped current_execution_subject requires restart_authoritative and fails after terminal stop invalidates old binding. require_current_execution_subject also fails for a stale previously captured snapshot. Do not bypass it for any provider action or relax ordinary execution admission.

A plan-only immutable risk/plan snapshot is already used by funding owner; it is not sufficient finalization authority. A narrow canonical-only finalizer must independently validate original saved E6 chain, lease/process/runtime revision, claim generation and explicit recover reason allowlist. Do not reuse funding _context unchanged or fabricate READY.

First preparation can permit only the precise expected reinterpretation state with complete settled source facts; saved-batch replay must permit its own partial publication states without granting provider capability. No generic recovery status exception.

Do not reattest the old flat projection merely to gain authority unless deliberately designed: direct CLOSED transition already consumes the exact previous flat state and creates the required fresh binding. Intermediate reattestation would add an unnecessary lifecycle revision and alter the saved recipe.

validation: Follow ProductFunding _batch/effects pattern: fixed exact keys/types, bounded JSON/hash verification, no provider-native fields in canonical effects, exact three ordered kinds; canonical validators for result/projection/binding and recomputation from referenced actual source facts before initial commit. Keep native evidence only E6 local.

Under journal._write use existing live lease/process/revision checks and require_claim_inventory_generation. Resolve original rows by exact immutable keys/hashes and require same FIXTURE namespace/profile. Enforce interpreted_at valid once, no future timestamps, immutable ID collision rejection. Use append-only outbox + separate publication receipt with INSERT OR REPLACE/update/delete denial as existing product outboxes.

Replay validates saved batch and exact referenced immutable source rows before any write, compares complete canonical commitments allowing only its own exact effects already present. No re-clock/rebuild IDs, ledger read, cancel or submit. Receipt requires exact stored effects_hash and final graph equality; same repeat returns original receipt without lifecycle revision/provider effects.

replay_states: Before first effect: expected REINTERPRETATION_REQUIRED only; publish saved CLOSED.
After CLOSED only: INCOMPLETE with CLOSED_POSITION_TRADE_RESULT_MISSING plus LIFECYCLE_EXECUTION_BINDING_MISSING; replay same CLOSED then binding.
After CLOSED+binding: INCOMPLETE with CLOSED_POSITION_TRADE_RESULT_MISSING; replay same first two then TradeResult.
After all effects before receipt: READY/CLOSED exact expected graph; mark original receipt.
Any unrelated mutation, wrong source hash, current projection successor/new order/fill or conflict: deny; do not swallow all INCOMPLETE states.
